subject_session: 6 sessions across subjects 10073/10697/10704/10884; example sub-10704 ses-20060402

justification.dataset: DANDI:000582 (Sargolini/Moser dorsocaudal MEC open-field) is the canonical grid-cell dataset, exactly appropriate.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3, position NaN-dropped and speed-filtered correctly, but inclusion is only a >=100-spike floor with no unit-quality or histology/region filtering.
justification.analysis: Standard rate map, Pearson spatial autocorrelogram, and rotational gridness score with a proper circular spike-time shuffle null and 95th-percentile threshold.
justification.correctness: Headline values (8/31, threshold 0.44, gridness up to 1.22) reproduce in the transcript and are internally consistent across README and all figures with sound shuffle statistics.
justification.figures: Figures are clear and labeled with units and sample sizes; the textbook example and top-8 gallery (sorted by gridness, the effect itself) let a reader see the hexagonal signature directly.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up names no specific limitation (single sessions per animal, small unit count, near-threshold cells), so it sits at generic rather than fully calibrated.
